summary: Iteration 86 - Zendesk P0 Bug Fix Verification Complete. The P0 bug 'No Zendesk connection found' when clicking Test button is FIXED. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified the fix - clicking Test button now shows 'Authorization Expired' (expected in test env) instead of 'No Zendesk connection found'.
critical_code_review_comments: P0 Bug Fix Verified: selectBot() in AuthContext.js (lines 270-292) now correctly creates synthetic instance with legacy_instance_id when bot has legacy ID but it's not in user's instances array
Root cause confirmed: zendesk_config collection is keyed on legacy_instance_id (88bfae82-2533-4235-968d-b3298fd57073), not V2 bot ID (f014cae7-788f-447c-b524-7d72709daa80)
User's /auth/me instances array contains V2 bot IDs, not legacy IDs - the fix bridges this gap
ZendeskSettings.js correctly uses selectedInstance.id and lockedInstanceId for X-Instance-ID header
Backend _verify_instance_access properly validates access via V2 workspace membership fallback
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing test data
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 Zendesk bug is fixed. Key IDs: API Tester V2 bot ID=f014cae7-788f-447c-b524-7d72709daa80, legacy_instance_id=88bfae82-2533-4235-968d-b3298fd57073. Zendesk config is keyed on legacy ID. The fix in selectBot() creates synthetic instance when legacy ID not in user's instances. Test button now shows 'Authorization Expired' (expected - OAuth token expired in test env) instead of 'No Zendesk connection found'.
